exports.name: List
exports.signature: class List<T> { constructor(o: ListOptions<T>): List<T> }
exports.doc: A grouped, scrolling list with a cursor, marks and metadata columns.

members.name: items
members.doc: The rows, in display order; replace through `setItems`.

members.name: hover
members.doc: Index of the row under the pointer, if any; shown bold.

members.name: setItems()
members.doc: Replaces the items; marks of items that are gone are dropped and the cursor kept in range.

members.name: move()
members.doc: Moves the cursor by `delta` rows, clamped to the list, and clears the hover.

members.name: toggle()
members.doc: Marks or unmarks the item; `single` clears any other mark first.

members.name: picked()
members.doc: The marked items, or the one under the cursor when none is marked.

members.name: naturalRows()
members.doc: Lines the whole list takes at `width`, blank rows between groups included.

members.name: render()
members.doc: At most `rows` lines. Blank rows between groups only while everything fits. Past that the window scrolls by whole rows, keeping the cursor's row (and its group header) in view, and a dim `↑ n more` / `↓ n more` line stands in for the rows that are hidden.

members.name: hit()
members.doc: The item under a point of the last render (local cells), and whether it is on the mark.

members.name: mouse()
members.doc: Click selects a row (its mark toggles it); hovering lights one. Coordinates are the list's own.

rows.name: id
rows.doc: A stable key: marks follow it when the items are replaced.

rows.name: group
rows.doc: Items sharing a group sit together under one header. Give them in group order.

rows.name: title
rows.doc: The row's text: the content, the last thing cut.

rows.name: titleLines
rows.doc: Passed to `clamp` for every title.

rows.name: columns
rows.doc: Metadata fields, right-aligned after the title; the lowest priority drops first.

rows.name: marks
rows.doc: `multi` is `□ ■`, `single` is `○ ●`; none leaves the mark column out.

rows.name: min
rows.doc: Fewer lines than this are padded with blank ones, so rows keep one height.

rows.name: max
rows.doc: More lines than this are cut, the last filled to its end before the `…`.

rows.name: target
rows.doc: A length in characters: as many lines as that much text needs at this width.

types.name: Column
types.doc: A right-aligned metadata field, one fixed width on every row.

rows.name: width
rows.doc: Cells, the same on every row so the field can be scanned downwards.

rows.name: priority

rows.name: text
rows.doc: The field's value, cut to `width` with `…`.

rows.doc: A colour that marks a threshold or a state; dim when it returns nothing.
